verdicts.why: શક્ય 'possible' is a literal gloss of a word the seed ('as soon as you can') renders as 'can', and it matches its own LEGO.
'as is possible' is a literal gloss of 'as soon as I can' and sits inside its own LEGO's span.
કરત 'would do' is the literal verb of the LEGO 'would help you', but the seed has 'would help you' and no 'do'.
જ 'exactly' is a particle gloss within the LEGO એટલે જ => 'that is why'.
લાંબું is in the seed's own LEGO (વધારે લાંબું => longer), but its gloss 'time' is wrong. 'Longer' is not forced, so this is not provably a cut or a fix.
કે 'that' is a particle gloss within the LEGO 'I don't feel as if'; the seed renders no 'that'.
લઈ 'bring' is half of the LEGO લઈ આવું => 'fetch'; the seed has 'fetch'.
લેવાનો 'to take' is part of the LEGO 'to try and breathe'; the seed has no 'take'.
'which is the most interesting' has 'do you think' interposed in the seed ('which of those places do you think is the most interesting').
ઓરડામાં 'in the room' sits in the LEGO 'in another room'; the seed says 'in another room', so the gloss differs.
બીક 'fear' is the noun behind the seed's 'afraid', within its LEGO.
'will call' appears in the seed only as the contraction "I'll call".
હવે 'now' is a literal gloss within the LEGO હવે વધારે => 'any more'.
કે 'that' is a particle gloss within the LEGO 'did you hear'; the seed has no 'that'.
મળશે 'get' is the literal verb in the LEGO શું મને મળશે => 'can I have'; the seed says 'have'.
હોય 'are' appears in the seed only inside the contraction "they're".
'will be ready' appears in the seed only as the contraction "I'll be ready".
પહેલાં 'before' is the literal gloss of a word the seed renders as 'ago' (LEGO 'a week ago').
રાત્રે 'at night' is within the LEGO 'on Friday night'; the seed has 'night' preceded by 'Friday', not 'at night'.
નથી 'there's not' is the negation within the LEGO 'there's no point'; the seed has "There's no point".
